_admin_guide.title: TheLinkPanda — Contribution Review & Paste Guide
_admin_guide.purpose: Reference for reviewing community submissions and formatting approved entries for pasting into index.html
workflow: 1. Submission arrives by email via Web3Forms
2. TheLinkPanda reviews — verify source, check wording, confirm evidence exists
3. If approved: format the entry using the examples below
4. Paste into the correct array in index.html (MISCONCEPTIONS, QUOTES, or EVIDENCE)
5. Set the next sequential ID (mc-031, ev-027, etc.)
6. git commit + push → Cloudflare deploys automatically
7. Contributor credit appears on site immediately after deploy

_worked_example_1_misconception._comment: SUBMISSION EMAIL RECEIVED — contributor submitted this via /contribute

_raw_submission.details: People keep saying Chainlink only works on Ethereum mainnet and can't support private/permissioned chains used by banks.
_raw_submission.why_it_matters: This is used to argue that banks will never use Chainlink. SWIFT and DTCC both run on private infrastructure.

_formatted_entry_ready_to_paste.location_in_file: Inside var MISCONCEPTIONS=[...] in index.html, after the last mc-0XX entry

entry.title: Chainlink only works on public blockchains
entry.myth: Chainlink can't connect to private or permissioned chains used by banks and institutions.
entry.reality: Chainlink CCIP and its oracle infrastructure are explicitly designed to bridge public and private blockchains. Swift's interoperability experiments and JPMorgan's Kinexys DvP settlement both involved Chainlink connecting across public and private chain boundaries.

_worked_example_3_evidence_source._comment: SUBMISSION EMAIL RECEIVED — contributor found a timestamped video quote

_raw_submission.details: At 5:12 in this Fidelity panel at TOKEN2049, Emma Pecenicic says: 'We now provide daily Proof of Reserve for all of our tokenized fund products, and Chainlink is how we do that.' This is a newer and clearer quote than what is currently in ev-005.

_review_checklist.timestamp_verified: MUST WATCH — go to youtube.com/watch?v=EXAMPLE123&t=312s and confirm quote at 5:12
_review_checklist.quote_verbatim: MUST VERIFY — transcribe directly from video, do not rely on contributor transcription
_review_checklist.speaker_confirmed: Emma Pecenicic — confirm she is still in the same role
_review_checklist.event_confirmed: TOKEN2049 — check event name and date in video description
_review_checklist.supersedes_existing: If verified, update ev-005 body + timestamp rather than creating a duplicate

options: A: Update ev-005 with the new timestamp and corrected body (preferred if quote is better)
B: Add as ev-027 if it is genuinely a different statement from a different event
C: Reject if quote is not verbatim or event cannot be confirmed

Speaker role or attribution is uncertain
Source URL is behind a paywall with no accessible alternative
Misconception reality is speculative rather than evidence-backed
Evidence entry duplicates an existing entry without improvement
Institution cannot be confirmed as named in the submission
